coordinate_system.origin: front-left corner of finished bench footprint
coordinate_system.x_axis: left to right along the 90 in wall
coordinate_system.y_axis: front/infeed to rear/outfeed across the 48 in depth

mobility_system.selected_product: Foot Master GD-60F plate-mount leveling caster
mobility_system.notes: This replaces light-duty retractable workbench caster kits. Supplemental fixed leveling feet stay optional only if the floor needs more range.

top.geometry_status: The top is now a fixed 90 x 48 surface. The only intentional interruptions are the table-saw fit opening, the router plate recess, and the centered miter-station flip-top bay.

modules.name: left_storage
modules.notes: Three drawers plus one vertical cubby

modules.name: saw_chassis
modules.notes: Open frame for saw cradle dust elbow movement, wrench access, and the centered front miter-station bay.

modules.name: right_service
modules.notes: Router above and Hercules plus Low-Pro below. No full-height divider may intrude into the rail keep-clear lanes.

front_service_face.notes: RM-06 is the plain removable dust-access face. RM-10 is a separate removable control cassette that must come off or disconnect first.

disconnects: releaseable slack loop for flex-hose dock
quick disconnect or union for manifold hose if the chosen hardware requires it
control_subpanel.notes: RM-10 carries the manifold, aux switch, and flex-hose dock on its own removable plate so RM-06 can still come off cleanly.

saw.geometry_status: Table-saw geometry stays driven by the stripped-saw survey. Final mount-hole drilling remains field-fit on the adjustable mounting deck.

blade_center.precision_cut_gate: The numerical survey gate can open once the required stripped-saw values are recorded, but actual saw fit remains a separate field gate before machining.

rail_envelope.notes: Measured union envelope using 7 in left projection at minimum rip, 18-5/8 in right projection at maximum rip, 2-1/2 in front overhang, and 1-5/8 in rear overhang.

coarse_support.type: fixed side ledgers plus adjustable mounting deck
coarse_support.notes: The saw sits on a full mounting deck sized to the cast-top footprint zone. Drill the final mount holes only after the saw is set flush on the deck.

fine_adjustment.pad_type: steel cup or nylon tip against mounting-deck support pads

locking_order: snug ledgers and deck supports with jack screws loose
bring the mounting deck and saw to final height with jack screws
verify top flushness at all four cast-top corners and both saw-top support transitions

relief_zones.name: underside-protrusion relief only
relief_zones.notes: Use only where real saw underside interference requires it and never at the main stock-support edges.

relief_zones.name: mount-access relief only
relief_zones.notes: Local relief is allowed only where it helps wrench or fastener access after real saw fit-up.

opening.notes: Final opening is field-fit only after the recorded survey values are reconciled against the actual saw set flush on the mounting deck.

under_top_keep_clear.name: front_rail_lane
under_top_keep_clear.notes: No divider, wiring chase, hose bracket, or subpanel cleat may intrude into this lane above the plinth.

under_top_keep_clear.name: rear_rail_lane
under_top_keep_clear.notes: No divider, wiring chase, hose bracket, or subpanel cleat may intrude into this lane above the plinth.

under_top_mechanism_zone.notes: The flip-top mechanism must stay ahead of the front rail keep-clear lane and left of the right-side service module.

flip_top.notes: The stowed cover returns the bench to a flush work surface. Public saw dimensions lock the envelope, while the real tray height still gets tuned with hard stops and mount shims during fit-up.

deployed_envelope.notes: Concept-only above-top envelope sized from the conservative public DeWalt listing and biased forward so the optional assembly overlay stays clear.

fence_line.notes: Support spans are measured by the available left and right stop-support surfaces adjacent to the saw.

dust_strategy.notes: The miter saw uses a deployed-only flexible hose path to the top-exit dust port rather than forcing a permanent fourth internal branch or a fixed station hose.

service_access.battery_swap_policy: top access with the station deployed

saw_mount_adjustment.strategy: hard stops plus shimmed or spaced saw feet
saw_mount_adjustment.tray_height_datum: FT-03 deployed hard stops and FAST-14 adjustment screws
saw_mount_adjustment.saw_to_tray_tuning: field-fit shim pack or spacer pucks under the real saw feet before drilling the final tray bolt pattern
saw_mount_adjustment.stowed_close_tuning: FT-02 latch blocks plus FAST-13 latches
saw_mount_adjustment.notes: This separates tray motion from final saw-surface tuning so the station can hit both stowed-flush and deployed-flush targets without needing a bespoke prebuild survey.

fence_mount_zone.notes: Reserved for removable fence hardware and dust pickup.

access_hatch.notes: Provides reach to the router collet, lift hardware, and cabinet dust branch.

mockup_gate.notes: The internal Hercules plus Low-Pro package is still concept-only until real machine and fitting mockup confirms serviceability.

service_sequence: remove RM-10 control subpanel or disconnect its tethered services

packages.name: hercules_extractor_rear
packages.base_type: fixed low deck or UHMW skid base

dust_bay.notes: This bay intentionally models an internal Hercules plus Low-Pro package with front service. Default extractor support is now a fixed low deck or low-friction skid and not a pull-out tray.

manifold.plumbing_sequence: tools to manifold manifold to Low-Pro inlet Low-Pro outlet to Hercules vacuum port

saw_branch.hatch_dependency: Requires stripped-saw dust-port and hose-sweep survey before final routing holes are drilled.

router_branch.split_strategy: local Y-split inside router cavity for fence pickup plus cabinet pickup

tool_circuit.notes: Saw and router are never intended to run simultaneously on this branch.

control_strategy.extractor_start: RF remote or similar because split circuits disable current-sensing auto-start

garage_prerequisites: Two real garage circuits if simultaneous saw plus dust use is expected
GFCI-protected garage receptacles or equivalent code-compliant protection
Cord routing and strain relief that works in parked and rolled-out positions

underside_stiffener.location: Runs under the overlay where it spans the saw opening or other unsupported cutouts.

overlay.support_policy: Underside stiffener is mandatory over unsupported openings. The lowered saw top and stowed miter station may only act as incidental backup and never as the primary clamp-load support.

table_saw_infeed_support.notes: Optional later package. It must not drive the core fixed-top geometry or reintroduce a precision-wing dependency.
